ge_pathway.name: California General Education Transfer Curriculum
ge_pathway.total_units_note: 34 semester units is derived by summing the minimums for Areas 1-6; the 5C lab is embedded within the Area 5 science requirement rather than added on top.
ge_pathway.transfer_scope_statement: The source says Cal-GETC may satisfy lower-division general education before transfer to CSU or UC; it is accepted by all CSU campuses and most UC campuses/programs.

requirements.name: English Communication
requirements.rule: Complete one course in each subarea 1A, 1B, and 1C.

requirements.name: Arts and Humanities
requirements.rule: Complete one course in each subarea 3A and 3B.

requirements.name: Social and Behavioral Sciences
requirements.rule: Complete two courses from two academic disciplines or in an interdisciplinary sequence.

requirements.name: Physical and Biological Sciences
requirements.rule: Complete one course in 5A and one course in 5B; one of the two courses must include a laboratory satisfying 5C.

subareas.name: Laboratory
subareas.note: Laboratory requirement; may be embedded in a 5A or 5B course.

notes: This dataset is Cal-GETC, not the older IGETC course list.
Course eligibility, aliases, effective terms, cross-listed/same-as relationships, and former course numbers/titles are transcribed from the supplied ASSIST PDF.
A course can appear in more than one Cal-GETC area; cal_getc_areas lists every area shown in the source.
Effective-begin/effective-end values use the source's term notation (for example F2025 and Su2026).
This file is for Porterville College, not Chabot College.
